scope: BASELINE GEOMETRY MEASURED: in the working hybrid body the ps block is exactly ONE bit (has-ps = 0)
significance: the known-good body works because its ps block is a single 'no playerstate' bit - the whole ps payload is skipped
everything after that single bit is the actors/glass/EOF tail
our ps block (28 bits) shifts the tail by 27 bits, and when we place the same 27 tail bits at 1336 the actors block then consumes 46 bits and overruns
so the tail bits alone are not enough - the actors block's behaviour changes once a real playerstate is present (it likely depends on a ps field such as commandTime)
